cohorts.scope: 2026 sixth-generation RAV4 HEV owner pool, US FWD/AWD LE, XLE Premium and Limited; no older-year pooling warning observed.
cohorts.summary: New-generation owners rate the hybrid driving and efficiency positively; some report infotainment setup/connectivity and interior-material compromises.
positiveThemes: Smooth hybrid operation and low fuel use
Useful space and comfortable ride in positive reports
negativeThemes: Phone connection and setup frustrations in some accounts
Interior plastics and upper-trim value concerns
cohorts.limitations: Fourteen self-selected reports; related US trim/equipment, mixed FWD/AWD and short ownership. Not an Australian GXL-only sample or measured failure rate. Does not apply to the preceding XA50 generation.

matches.note: Same all-new HEV generation; related US FWD/AWD trims and support, not Australian GXL-specific evidence.

cohorts.scope: Dashboard-calculated mean of five individually read 2025 export Long Range RWD owner reviews; latest reported mileages 1,000, 13,000, 15,000, 23,052 and 24,500 km.
cohorts.summary: Calculated mean (7.0 + 9.5 + 8.0 + 8.0 + 9.5) / 5 = 8.4/10. These are each owner's vehicle scores, not reader helpfulness percentages or comment counts.
positiveThemes: Owners generally praise comfort, space and charging capability
negativeThemes: Several accounts report software, voice-control or driver-assistance frustrations; experiences vary
cohorts.limitations: Small self-selected European lease-owner sample, not a publisher-wide or representative survey. One account covers only a week; no VIN ownership audit. Software, LHD equipment, service and climate differ from Australia. No AWD air-suspension reports included. Related smaller-battery RWD relevance is lower.

matches.note: Related European 100-kWh export Long Range RWD; Australian equipment, support and software differ.
Related export rear-drive cabin, but different battery chemistry/capacity and Australian support; limited relevance.
